items.title: Microchip Technology (MCHP) Unveiled A Space Atomic Clock For Satellites
items.summary: Microchip Technology (NasdaqGS:MCHP) announced a new radiation tolerant Space CSAC SA65 atomic clock for satellite systems, aimed at compact and energy efficient timing in orbit. The company also introduced a major upgrade to its PolarFire FPGA Ethernet Sensor Bridge to support AI driven edge sensor connectivity for cameras.
